purpose: Verify lossless bounded storage and byte callback reuse without changing estimator, world, draw-count, scientific threshold or complete-series requirements.
fixed_encoding: study-stream-gzip/1: fixed 10-byte header, level6 raw DEFLATE, 65536-byte decoded input chunks, final remainder, CRC32 and exact length footer; zlib build/runtime versions bound.

findings.before: Direct compressobj.compress calls on arbitrary caller writes produced different DEFLATE bytes for identical decoded data. The independent fragmentation and GzipFile-reference tests failed.
findings.after: A bounded 65536-byte input buffer fixes compressor boundaries independently of caller writes. Empty/Hello goldens, repeated text, hash-derived bytes and split points 65535/65536/65537 pass.
findings.oracle_qualification: The first GzipFile comparison used its implicit Python3.14 buffering. The final separate GzipFile reference explicitly flushes only its input buffer after each fixed chunk, never gzip.flush/Z_SYNC_FLUSH. This matches the versioned chunk rule without claiming arbitrary gzip implementation byte identity.

reviewed_invariants: Encoded and decoded limits are separate. Header, body and footer emissions are checked; supplied streams remain caller-owned. Failed output prefixes remain available and no destructor can append bytes.

Decode validates exact metadata shapes/types/runtime binding, fixed header, one complete member, decoded hash/size and bounded expansion. Truncation, corrupt CRC/body, concatenation and arbitrary trailing bytes are rejected.
A forged small decoded size/hash cannot bypass the runtime decompression bound; no unbounded flush or whole-body gzip.decompress path is used.
Replay regenerates canonical records, recompresses using fixed chunks and compares every encoded byte plus final EOF. Hash equality alone does not replace exact replay.
The parent verifies actual compressed-file hash/size and decoded descriptor, retains encoding in proofs and rejects format/metadata switches between generation and replay.
Old five-field raw responses still select fixed JSONL paths; new six-field encoded responses select fixed gzip paths. Retained source content is not string-inspected to infer encoding.
Both old/new fixed output paths, errors and partial files remain retained and physically charged through existing finally/stat accounting.

The family fast callback reuses the calculator canonical draw bytes and JSON-escapes response IDs. Complete framed bytes match the dictionary path, including undefined values and quote/backslash/newline/non-ASCII IDs.

zlib/struct are imported by the transport module before child environment capture; the existing standard-library/runtime identity checks include their loaded files. gzip is used only by the independent test reference.
No estimator calculation, seed recipe, draw count, event definition, aggregate budget or scientific admission threshold was changed.

checks.baseline_note: The current independent test was imported against the preserved source-before ZIP. Package provenance was asserted before discovery. One expected missing-module error is recorded, not 15 executed failing cases.
checks.mock_signature_note: Only the existing synthetic bootstrap helper signature was adapted to accept on_draw_bytes; the global-deadline expected results were not changed.

fixed_byte_oracles.framing_qualification: Mocked calculator outputs isolate canonical framing; actual full result/draw equality is separately exercised by the paired retained-source transport test.

actual_paired_observation.qualification: One paired synthetic observation; not full-series feasibility or market calibration.

resource_projection.qualification: Illustrative same-workload scaling only. It still exceeds existing full-series limits. No actual 1024-world study was executed, and scenario costs need not be identical.

limits: The single ordered old/new observation supports storage savings and exact result/decoded-stream equality for this workload. It shows no runtime speed gain and does not estimate a general speedup.
A valid encoded blob is lossless transport evidence, not scientific truth or a completed calibration. The decoder does not independently authenticate arbitrary supplied event meanings.
No complete final calibration, model adequacy, protected market evaluation, N_min, scientific freeze or profitable outcome is demonstrated.
Storage accounting remains logical materialization/retention accounting, not an operating-system disk/memory quota. Complete-workload feasibility remains open.
Other long-running parent regressions are excluded until terminal evidence exists; this review is not a full repository suite.
next_action: Retain current regression outcomes and measure the remaining cost of complete prescribed cohorts before any full-series feasibility claim. Preserve the fixed world inventory and all required draw evidence.
